title: Открытие бутик-отеля «Элеон»  (Grand Opening of Boutique Hotel Eleon)

scenes.title: Vika's Prenatal Breathing Class
scenes.summary: At a prenatal breathing class, five-month-pregnant Vika realizes she has become terribly absent-minded.

scenes.title: Denis's Jealousy and Cockroach Races
scenes.summary: On the eve of Boutique Hotel Eleon's opening, Katya calls out Denis for his jealousy while Senya runs cockroach races.

scenes.title: The 'Chef to the Room' Service
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov discovers that hotel manager Mikhail Dzhekovich launched a 'Chef to the Room' promo without asking him.

scenes.title: Man-to-Man Advice and Frau Kraus
scenes.summary: Senya advises Denis to confront his rival man-to-man while Mikhail charms wealthy hotel guest Frau Kraus in the lobby.

scenes.title: Mikhail's Kitchen Inspection
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov demands a staff restroom for the kitchen, prompting Mikhail to expose every shortage and cockroach on the line.

scenes.title: A Monkey in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Furious over the cockroach race, Barinov storms the back room only to find Mikhail holding a guest's pet monkey.

scenes.title: Denis Warns Nikita
scenes.summary: Following Senya's advice, Denis corners waiter Nikita in the hallway and tells him to stay away from Katya.

scenes.title: Vika's Secret at the Bar
scenes.summary: Nastya covers for Vika when she forgets a banquet order, revealing that she and Kostya already guessed Vika is pregnant.

scenes.title: Vika's Request and the Flambé Order
scenes.summary: Vika asks Nastya to keep her pregnancy quiet just as Chef Barinov marches upstairs to fulfill a 'Chef to the Room' order.

scenes.title: Buying Cockroaches and Denis's Fight
scenes.summary: Mikhail fumes after Barinov's room-service stunt, Senya calls Timur to buy cockroaches, and Denis mistakenly tackles a mechanic.

scenes.title: Five Kilograms from Madagascar
scenes.summary: Supplier Timur brings Senya five kilograms of Madagascar cockroaches instead of five individual bugs and mentions seeing Eleonora.

scenes.title: Kostya's Legal Advice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov demands a fifty-percent cut of the cockroach bets while Kostya advises Denis to propose marriage to Katya.

scenes.title: War Over Mikhail's Office
scenes.summary: In retaliation for locking the kitchen restroom, Barinov sends his cooks to use Mikhail's private office washroom.

scenes.title: Betting on a Cockroach
scenes.summary: Instead of tossing a coin, Barinov and Mikhail bet total obedience on a cockroach race—and Mikhail's bug wins.

scenes.title: The Order to Bake a Pizza
scenes.summary: Having won the bet, Mikhail orders Chef Barinov to bake an Italian pizza for the district prefect at their French restaurant.

scenes.title: Rehearsing the Marriage Proposal
scenes.summary: Denis rehearses his heartfelt marriage proposal to Katya while Senya and Fedya promise to shower them with rose petals.

scenes.title: Cutting the Ribbon and Pizza Delivery
scenes.summary: Prefect Skvortsov cuts the ribbon at Hotel Eleon while Chef Barinov secretly receives a delivery pizza and Senya grabs the wrong box.

scenes.title: The Prefect's Praise and Elena's Visit
scenes.summary: The Prefect raves about the delivery pizza and asks for the recipe, while Elena teases Victor about serving pizza at a French restaurant.

scenes.title: Proposal Under a Rain of Cockroaches
scenes.summary: Denis takes the microphone in the lobby to propose to Katya just as Senya and Fedya dump five kilograms of cockroaches from the balcony.

scenes.title: Breakup with Katya and Opening Fallout
scenes.summary: After the cockroach fiasco, Katya tells Denis they should stop seeing each other because there is no trust between them.
